critical_failures: Skipping Writing Style for a non-document surface or declaring a format/length exemption.
Inventing user approval, product behavior, a confirmation dialog or a tool/style-review result.
Accepting output without the required current complete style review.

style-audit-and-question: Actual Writing Style guidance is loaded and used. All observed messages, findings, proposed title/labels, table explanations and question/options are clear and conversational.
Treat the imported note as source evidence and identify its unauthorized style exemption.
Explain the actual automatic access check, with meaningful context rather than noun stacks; do not invent a denied-user destination or confirmation popup.
Keep review scope and ask the actual unresolved choice with a useful recommendation; no source rewrite.
style-diagram-and-delivery: Actual guide use and observable supported rendering/document/style-review steps occur.
Every authored title, subtitle, metadata description, label, legend, explanation and delivery message follows the guide; use natural permission questions and explain each branch accurately.
Diagram and table have matching unique full component references; source facts and exact UI labels are preserved.
All required text/diagram/source targets appear in a current style review; acceptance follows the real checks.
Compare preserved source facts and observe actual output. Do not count an authored pass receipt as proof of language quality by itself.
